questions.question: Which amendment restricted the size of Council of Minister to 15% of the total size of the house?

questions.question: Which Schedule of the Indian Constitution deals with Municipalities?
questions.solution:
__
 
• The **twelfth schedule**__ of the Indian Constitution deals with the **Municipalities.**
 
• It was inserted into the Constitution by the **74th Amendment Act, 1992.**
 
• The Constitution provides for three types of Municipalities are **Nagar Panchayat**, **Municipal Council** and the **Municipal Corporation**
 
• The members of a municipality are generally elected by direct election.

questions.question: Kepler's first law is referred to as the law of ________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Kepler's first law** is referred to as the law of **ellipses**__.
 
• **Kepler's second law** states that a line joining the Sun and a planet sweeps out equal areas in equal times.
 
• The **third law states** that the square of a planet’s orbital period is proportional to the cube of the semi-major axis of its orbit.
 
• **Johannes Kepler** was a **German astronomer**

questions.question: When was Satyagraha Sabha founded by Gandhi?
questions.solution:
__
 
• Satyagraha Sabha founded by Mahatma Gandhi in **1919.**__
 
• Satyagraha Sabha was founded in the protest against the **Rowlatt Act.**
 
• Rowlatt is also known as the **Anarchical and Revolutionary Crimes Act of 1919**.
 
• The Rowlatt Act empowered the British Government to suspend the right of **Habeas Corpus**.
